versos.grego: Περὶ δὲ τῶν πνευματικῶν, ἀδελφοί, οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν.

controles.web: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
controles.kjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
controles.livre: E quanto aos dons espirituais, irmãos, não quero que sejais ignorantes.

versos.grego: Οἴδατε ὅτι ὅτε ἔθνη ἦτε πρὸς τὰ εἴδωλα τὰ ἄφωνα ὡς ἂν ἤγεσθε ἀπαγόμενοι.

controles.web: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
controles.kjv: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
controles.livre: Vós sabeis que éreis gentios, vós vos desviáveis para os ídolos mudos, conforme éreis guiados.

versos.grego: διὸ γνωρίζω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἐν Πνεύματι Θεοῦ λαλῶν λέγει ΑΝΑΘΕΜΑ ΙΗΣΟΥΣ, καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται εἰπεῖν ΚΥΡΙΟΣ ΙΗΣΟΥΣ, εἰ μὴ ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ.

controles.web: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: Por isso eu vos deixo claro que ninguém que fala pelo Espírito de Deus chama a Jesus de maldito;  e ninguém pode dizer que Jesus é o Senhor, a não ser pelo Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: Διαιρέσεις δὲ χαρισμάτων εἰσίν, τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ Πνεῦμα·

controles.web: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
controles.kjv: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
controles.livre: E há variedade de dons, mas o Espírito é o mesmo.

versos.grego: καὶ διαιρέσεις διακονιῶν εἰσιν, καὶ ὁ αὐτὸς Κύριος·

controles.web: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
controles.kjv: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
controles.livre: E há variedade de trabalhos na Igreja ,mas o Senhor é o mesmo.

versos.grego: καὶ διαιρέσεις ἐνεργημάτων εἰσίν, ὁ δὲ αὐτὸς Θεός ὁ ἐνεργῶν τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν.

controles.web: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.
controles.kjv: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
controles.livre: E há variedade de operações, mas é o mesmo Deus que opera tudo em todos.

versos.grego: ἑκάστῳ δὲ δίδοται ἡ φανέρωσις τοῦ Πνεύματος πρὸς τὸ συμφέρον.

controles.web: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
controles.kjv: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
controles.livre: Mas a cada um é dada a manifestação do Espírito, para o que for conveniente.

versos.grego: ᾧ μὲν γὰρ διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος δίδοται λόγος σοφίας, ἄλλῳ δὲ λόγος γνώσεως κατὰ τὸ αὐτὸ Πνεῦμα,

controles.web: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;
controles.kjv: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
controles.livre: Porque a um é dada, pelo Espírito, palavra de sabedoria; e a outro palavra de conhecimento, pelo mesmo Espírito.

versos.grego: ἑτέρῳ πίστις ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ Πνεύματι, ἄλλῳ δὲ χαρίσματα ἰαμάτων ἐν τῷ ἑνὶ Πνεύματι,

controles.web: to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;
controles.kjv: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
controles.livre: e a outro fé pelo mesmo Espírito; e a outro dons de curas, pelo mesmo Espírito.

versos.grego: ἄλλῳ δὲ ἐνεργήματα δυνάμεων, ἄλλῳ δὲ προφητεία, ἄλλῳ δὲ διακρίσεις πνευμάτων, ἑτέρῳ γένη γλωσσῶν, ἄλλῳ δὲ ἑρμηνεία γλωσσῶν·

controles.web: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another different kinds of languages; and to another the interpretation of languages.
controles.kjv: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
controles.livre: E a outro operações de milagres; e a outro profecia; e a outro o dom de discernir aos espíritos; e a outro variedade de línguas; e a outro interpretação de línguas.

versos.grego: πάντα δὲ ταῦτα ἐνεργεῖ τὸ ἓν καὶ τὸ αὐτὸ Πνεῦμα, διαιροῦν ἰδίᾳ ἑκάστῳ καθὼς βούλεται.

controles.web: But the one and the same Spirit works all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
controles.kjv: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
controles.livre: Mas todas estas coisas quem opera é um e o mesmo Espírito, repartindo particularmente a cada um como quer.

versos.grego: Καθάπερ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα ἕν ἐστιν καὶ μέλη πολλὰ ἔχει, πάντα δὲ τὰ μέλη τοῦ σώματος πολλὰ ὄντα ἕν ἐστιν σῶμα, οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός·

controles.web: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
controles.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
controles.livre: Porque assim como o corpo é um, e tem muitos membros, e todos os membros deste único corpo, sendo muitos, compõem um só corpo; assim também é Cristo.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ἐν ἑνὶ Πνεύματι ἡμεῖς πάντες εἰς ἓν σῶμα ἐβαπτίσθημεν, εἴτε Ἰουδαῖοι εἴτε Ἕλληνες, εἴτε δοῦλοι εἴτε ἐλεύθεροι. καὶ πάντες ἓν Πνεῦμα ἐποτίσθημεν.

controles.web: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
controles.kjv: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
controles.livre: Porque também todos nós somos batizados em um só Espírito, para um só corpo, quer judeus, quer gregos, quer servos, quer livres; e para todos nós foi dado de beber um só Espírito.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα οὐκ ἔστιν ἓν μέλος ἀλλὰ πολλά.

controles.web: For the body is not one member, but many.
controles.kjv: For the body is not one member, but many.
controles.livre: Porque também o corpo não é um só membro, mas muitos.

versos.grego: ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ πούς Ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ χείρ, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος, οὐ παρὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ σώματος.

controles.web: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
controles.kjv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
controles.livre: Se o pé disser: Por eu não ser mão, não sou do corpo;Por isso, ele não é do corpo?

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν εἴπῃ τὸ οὖς Ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ ὀφθαλμός, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος, οὐ παρὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ σώματος.

controles.web: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
controles.kjv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
controles.livre: E se a orelha disser: Por eu não ser olho, não sou do corpo;Por isso, ela não é do corpo?

versos.grego: εἰ ὅλον τὸ σῶμα ὀφθαλμός, ποῦ ἡ ἀκοή; εἰ ὅλον ἀκοή, ποῦ ἡ ὄσφρησις;

controles.web: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
controles.kjv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
controles.livre: Se todo o corpo fosse olho, onde estaria o ouvido? Se fosse todo ouvido, onde estaria o olfato?

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἔθετο τὰ μέλη, ἓν ἕκαστον αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ σώματι καθὼς ἠθέλησεν.

controles.web: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
controles.kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
controles.livre: Mas agora Deus pôs os membros no corpo, a cada qual deles como ele quis.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἦν τὰ πάντα ἓν μέλος, ποῦ τὸ σῶμα;

controles.web: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
controles.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
controles.livre: Porque se todos fossem um só membro, onde estaria o corpo?

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ πολλὰ μὲν μέλη, ἓν δὲ σῶμα.

controles.web: But now they are many members, but one body.
controles.kjv: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
controles.livre: Mas há agora muitos membros, porém um só corpo.

versos.grego: οὐ δύναται δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμὸς εἰπεῖν τῇ χειρί Χρείαν σου οὐκ ἔχω, ἢ πάλιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῖς ποσίν Χρείαν ὑμῶν οὐκ ἔχω·

controles.web: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
controles.kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
controles.livre: E o olho não pode dizer à mão: Não tenho necessidade de ti;Nem a cabeça aos pés: Não tenho necessidade de vós;

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ πολλῷ μᾶλλον τὰ δοκοῦντα μέλη τοῦ σώματος ἀσθενέστερα ὑπάρχειν ἀναγκαῖά ἐστιν,

controles.web: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
controles.kjv: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
controles.livre: Antes até os membros do corpo que nos parecem ser os mais fracos, são muito mais necessários.

versos.grego: καὶ ἃ δοκοῦμεν ἀτιμότερα εἶναι τοῦ σώματος, τούτοις τιμὴν περισσοτέραν περιτίθεμεν, καὶ τὰ ἀσχήμονα ἡμῶν εὐσχημοσύνην περισσοτέραν ἔχει,

controles.web: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant propriety;
controles.kjv: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
controles.livre: E os que pensamos serem os menos honrados do corpo, a esses muito mais honramos; e os nossos mais desprezíveis têm muito mais respeito.

versos.grego: τὰ δὲ εὐσχήμονα ἡμῶν οὐ χρείαν ἔχει. ἀλλὰ ὁ θεὸς συνεκέρασεν τὸ σῶμα, τῷ ὑστερουμένῳ περισσοτέραν δοὺς τιμήν,

controles.web: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
controles.kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
controles.livre: Porém os nosso mais respeitáveis não têm tanta necessidade; mas assim Deus juntou o corpo, dando muito mais honra ao que tinha falta dela .

versos.grego: ἵνα μὴ ᾖ σχίσμα ἐν τῷ σώματι, ἀλλὰ τὸ αὐτὸ ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων μεριμνῶσιν τὰ μέλη.

controles.web: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
controles.kjv: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
controles.livre: Para que não haja divisão no corpo, mas que os membros tenham igual cuidado uns com os outros.

versos.grego: καὶ εἴτε πάσχει ἓν μέλος, συνπάσχει πάντα τὰ μέλη· εἴτε δοξάζεται μέλος, συνχαίρει πάντα τὰ μέλη.

controles.web: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
controles.kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
controles.livre: E seja que, caso um membro sofra, também os membros sofrem juntos; e caso um membro seja honrado, todos os membros se alegram juntos.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς δέ ἐστε σῶμα Χριστοῦ καὶ μέλη ἐκ μέρους.

controles.web: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
controles.kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
controles.livre: E vós sois o corpo de Cristo, e membros em particular.

versos.grego: Καὶ οὓς μὲν ἔθετο ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ πρῶτον ἀποστόλους, δεύτερον προφήτας, τρίτον διδασκάλους, ἔπειτα δυνάμεις, ἔπειτα χαρίσματα ἰαμάτων, ἀντιλήμψεις, κυβερνήσεις, γένη γλωσσῶν.

controles.web: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
controles.kjv: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
controles.livre: E Deus pôs a uns na Igreja: em primeiro lugar apóstolos, em segundo profetas, em terceiro mestres; depois milagres, dons de curas, socorros, lideranças, variedades de línguas.

versos.grego: μὴ πάντες ἀπόστολοι; μὴ πάντες προφῆται; μὴ πάντες διδάσκαλοι; μὴ πάντες δυνάμεις;

controles.web: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
controles.kjv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
controles.livre: Por acaso são todos apóstolos? São todos profetas? São todos mestres? São todos com dons de milagres?

versos.grego: μὴ πάντες χαρίσματα ἔχουσιν ἰαμάτων; μὴ πάντες γλώσσαις λαλοῦσιν; μὴ πάντες διερμηνεύουσιν;

controles.web: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
controles.kjv: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
controles.livre: Tem todos dons de curas? Falam todos várias línguas? Interpretam todos?

versos.grego: ζηλοῦτε δὲ τὰ χαρίσματα τὰ μείζονα. Καὶ ἔτι καθ’ ὑπερβολὴν ὁδὸν ὑμῖν δείκνυμι.

controles.web: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
controles.kjv: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
controles.livre: Porém desejai com zelo pelos melhores dons; e eu vos mostro um caminho ainda mais excelente.
